lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Soldier, Kaiju are headed for Kaiju City! Protect the Peninsula!!

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: The punk from the station finished re-education. He's working for us now. The mohawk stays, apparently.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: The punk from the station won't be a problem anymore. Cold, but clean.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Sonar shows a second wave off the coast. Bigger than the first.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Protect the Peninsula!!

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Another wave down. You two are holding this city together.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: They're coming faster than they used to...

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Well, you aren't slowing down either. Good use of your {power} power.

choices.text: Where are they all coming from?

reply.speaker: agent
reply.text: That's above your pay grade. For now.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Kaiju parts have been falling onto rooftops in the Cemetery district. Go investigate, and don't let another citizen touch one!

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Oh! And make sure you bring your Dispel ability. Something tells me you'll need it.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: The woman from the rooftop cemetery is through re-education. Her powers are like nothing we've seen.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Powerful, but they drain her health.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: You might need to babysit her, to keep her alive.

lines.speaker: Ghost Girl
lines.text: I don't need a babysitter.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Hey! How are you on this line??

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: The woman from the rooftop cemetery is in the ground. Fitting, for that address.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Woah! We've got Kaiju incoming!!

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: The biggest group yet... Get out there and do your thing!

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: The radar's quiet again. The mayor sends his thanks.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Quiet never lasts around here.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: No, it doesn't. Keep that {power} power charged.

choices.text: Is anyone looking into all these Kaiju parts?

reply.speaker: agent
reply.text: Yeah, you two! Speaking of which...

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Reports say severed Kaiju parts crashed into the Aquarium.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Your track record isn't great, but you know the drill.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Get there and make sure no one touches them! Go.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: The aquarium worker is in re-education. Mentally, she's a mermaid.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: But she's a hit with the lab techs! They love her.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: The mermaid is off the board. The Aquarium wants to know who's paying for the repairs...

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: All units, all units: Kaiju on every approach.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: This is everything they've got. Hold the Peninsula, whatever it takes! Kaiju inbound!!!

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Soldier, report to the Lab, on the double. The brains have cooked up something special for you.

radio.final.label: Final battle: radio call, the team alone (no Agent)

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: The Agent and his clones are dead. We did it.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Not yet! Look at the radar... every Kaiju left in the sea, all coming at once.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Then this is the last fight. We hold the Peninsula, together.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Together. I'm not scared, you know. I just feel... strange.

peninsula.finalTurn.label: Final battle: after the last Kaiju, the teammate turns

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: That's the last of them... isn't it?

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: That's all of them. We did it. The city's safe.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Then why can I still hear their roars?

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: My hands... they're burning. Something's wrong.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Mine are too.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Aghgh!! Must... destroy!

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: No, stay with me. We're in this together.

peninsula.finalTurnRecruits.label: Final battle: each recruit still standing, as they begin to turn with the teammate (by key)

lines.speaker: Punk Guy
lines.text: My skull's on fire... Get away from me, fool! I can't hold it!

lines.speaker: Ghost Girl
lines.text: Those aren't my ancestors calling... They're Kaiju!

lines.speaker: Aquarium Worker
lines.text: My skin... these are real scales! What's happening to me?!

lines.speaker: Hazmat Worker
lines.text: This suit was supposed to keep it out!

peninsula.finalTurnAfter.label: Final battle: the player turned too, mind intact, before the fight with the teammate

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I'm a Kaiju, but I'm still in control.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: My teammate's lost {teammate:his} mind. {teammate:He}'ll destroy the city. I have to stop {teammate:him}.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Forgive me, teammate.

peninsula.finalTurnAlone.label: Final battle: after the last Kaiju, with no teammate left, the player turns

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: That's the last of them...

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: We did it, teammate...

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Why can I still hear their roars? They're calling me...

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: My hands... they're burning. No... not me too...

rapidTransit.intro.label: Subway: Punk Guy finds the eye

lines.speaker: Punk Guy
lines.text: Ooo... pretty...

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: No, don't touch it!

lines.speaker: Punk Guy
lines.text: I do what I want!

rapidTransit.afterTouch.label: Subway: Punk Guy, the eye's power in him

lines.speaker: Punk Guy
lines.text: Whoa... I'm a superhero now!

rooftop.intro.label: Rooftop: Ghost Girl at the graves

lines.speaker: Ghost Girl
lines.text: Is someone there? I can hear them...

lines.speaker: Ghost Girl
lines.text: It's my ancestors... calling to me from beyond!

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Step away from that!

lines.speaker: Ghost Girl
lines.text: They're so ANGRY. They want me to touch it!

aquarium.intro.label: Aquarium: the worker and the tongue

lines.speaker: Aquarium Worker
lines.text: I'M A MERMAID!!

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: She must work here... the Kaiju radiation's scrambled her brain, like the others.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Ma'am, don't touch that!

aquarium.stopScream.label: Aquarium: brought to zero, her scream shatters the glass

lines.speaker: Aquarium Worker
lines.text: Stop!!!

aquarium.toCreatures.label: Aquarium: up on the walkway, to the sea creatures

lines.speaker: Aquarium Worker
lines.text: Attack the invaders, my beauties!

lines.speaker: Ghost Girl
lines.text: I can feel their power flowing through me!

rooftop.ghostScream.label: Rooftop: brought to zero, before her scream (one line for each phase)

lines.speaker: Ghost Girl
lines.text: Protect me, ancestors!

lines.speaker: Ghost Girl
lines.text: Ancestors, rise! Guard your blood!

lines.speaker: Ghost Girl
lines.text: Every soul in this ground... protect me!

rooftop.guardian.label: Rooftop: the teammate, the first time one of Ghost Girl's Haunt ghosts is in view (the player has no Dispel)

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Let's stick together. I'll block her ghosts.

lines.speaker: recruit
lines.text: Jumping into the sewers was quick thinking.

lines.speaker: recruit
lines.text: That swanky Agent will never look for us down here.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Our powers are gone.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: But maybe we can get them back...

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: You mean... touch some fallen Kaiju parts??

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Look at them. Still empowered. The Agent's ray gun didn't work on them.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: {recruit}'s still empowered. The Agent's ray gun didn't work.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Are you sure you didn't touch some already??

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: That much Kaiju radiation... it does something to you.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: And that's just what we can see. Who knows what else it does.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Yeah, but...

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: With powers, we can fight back. Do you really want to leave this city to the Agent?

lines.speaker: recruit
lines.text: What's that glow?

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Are those... Kaiju parts?

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: They are!

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: They must be specimens from the Lab.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Flushed down the pipes once the scientists were done with them.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: So... should we touch them?

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: There's no taking it back. Whatever it does to us...

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: I know...

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I'm glad it was you out there with me.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Me too.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: You always had my back.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: We were in it together. We *ARE* in it together.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Even with this, I guess.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Yeah...

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Okay. It's settled, then.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: It is.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Let's do it.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Mr. Agent Man, we're coming for you.

street.greeting.label: Street: the Agent calls the team over

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Soldier, over here!

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Good work out there. Though you guys made a mess!

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Careful around those Kaiju parts. They're toxic.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: One touch and you're changed for good.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Speaking of which: bystanders are gathering at the West Rapid Transit station.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Get there before someone touches one!

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Stop by the Lab on your way if you want to swap your abilities.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: The scientists just discovered a new one: Teleport.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Could come in handy at the station. But be quick!

street.hazmatJoins.label: The Street: the Hazmat Worker joins the team (stepping on his tile)

lines.speaker: Hazmat Worker
lines.text: I'm sick of this gig. I'm coming with you.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Welcome to the Lab.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: *nervous* Oh, those?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Just some R&D into cloning... nerd stuff.

lab.beforeTrap.label: The Lab, before the trap: the Agent isn't there

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: The Agent's not here...

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Let's look around for him.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: But choose your powers before we go. Who knows when we'll get another chance...

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: You both glow with Kaiju radiation! How??

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: We found the Kaiju parts you flushed.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Ha... ha ha...

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: HA HA HA HA HA HA HA!

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: What's so funny?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Powers from Kaiju parts are inherently unstable, soldier.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Usually the mind goes first, then the body. But sometimes it's the other way around...

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Poor bastards. Human minds, stuck in Kaiju bodies.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: All these Kaiju... Where did you think they were coming from?

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: No...

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Every one of them was a soldier or a citizen.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Failed experiments.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Sure, a few are the natural kind. But those are rare...

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Welp... time to put you out of your misery, before you turn or lose your minds.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Agents, assemble!!

lab.transformation.label: Lab fight: after the clones, the teammate transforms

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Something's wrong... my hands... they're burning.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Hey. Hey, look at me. Breathe.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Get away from me! I can't... hold it...

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: No... no, no, no.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: You did well, soldier.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: But there's been a breakthrough. We no longer need your services.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Meet the new team: me!

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Clones!

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: For your commendable service, you're granted an honorable discharge... and a swift death!

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Our powers... they're gone!

lines.speaker: recruit
lines.text: Huh. I still have mine...

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Seize them!

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Get them! Don't let them escape!

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Run! Get to the exit, now!

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: The others will hold them off! Run for the exit!

lines.speaker: recruit
lines.text: I'll hold them off! Run for the exit!

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Not much to do here...

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: ...but it could be a good place to train.

training.offer.label: A battleground visited again: the recruit offers to train the player in their power (Recruit training)

lines.speaker: Punk Guy
lines.text: Hey, fool. Want my power? Beat me one on one and I'll teach it to you. It's only for the elite, y'know?

lines.speaker: Ghost Girl
lines.text: I can teach you my power. Face me alone, if you're unafraid.

lines.speaker: Aquarium Worker
lines.text: Hey, beautiful! Charm is more than a pretty smile. Beat me one on one, and I'll show you.

training.start.label: Recruit training: the recruit, as the one-on-one fight starts

lines.speaker: Punk Guy
lines.text: You're on my turf now, fool!

lines.speaker: Ghost Girl
lines.text: May your ancestors grant you humility in defeat.

lines.speaker: Aquarium Worker
lines.text: You'll be another notch in my belt soon enough, precious.

training.won.label: Back in the battleground after their training is won: the recruit, on the power the player has now

lines.speaker: Punk Guy
lines.text: Overgrowth's yours now. But remember: you reap what you sow.

lines.speaker: Ghost Girl
lines.text: Haunt is yours. My ancestors would be proud.

lines.speaker: Aquarium Worker
lines.text: Now you can Charm them too. Use it wisely.

training.labNote.label: After the recruit's word on a power won in training: the teammate on where to use it

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: You can add it to your powers at the Lab, or swap the ones you have.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Swing by the Lab when you get a chance. You can add it to your powers there.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: The Lab can set you up with that one. Swap it in whenever you like.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Don't forget, the Lab's where you choose your powers. It's there for you now.

sparring.offer.label: A battleground visited again, its bystander terminated: the teammate offers to spar, for health

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: We could fight each other. Get tougher...

sparring.start.label: Sparring: the teammate, as the one-on-one fight starts

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Don't hold back. I won't.

sparring.again.label: Back in the battleground after sparring is won, with more to win: the teammate

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Good job. You didn't hold back. Ready to go again whenever you are.

sparring.goAgain.label: A battleground sparred in before, visited again: the teammate

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Want to go again?

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Heads-up, teammate. Here they come!

recruit.choice.label: Every recruit choice: the teammate over the bystander

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: I guess we're going to {last} {him}, like the others?

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Recruit {him}, and the crew grows by one...

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: ...or study {his} DNA and take {his} power. That would be fatal for {him}.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: I guess we're going to terminate {him}, like the others?

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: There's no crew to grow... it's just been the two of us.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: We could recruit {him}, and start one... or take {his} power, and it would be fatal for {him}.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: We have recruited, and we have terminated...

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Recruit {him}, and we gain a crew member...

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: ...or terminate {him}, and harvest {his} power.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Another one... The last one joined the crew.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: We could recruit {him} too, and grow the team...

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: ...or study {his} DNA and take {his} power. That would be fatal for {him}.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Last time, we took the power for ourselves.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: We could study {his} DNA again, and take {his} power. It would be fatal for {him}...

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: ...or we could recruit {him}, bring {him} onto the crew.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Maybe we could recruit {him}...

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: ...or we could study {his} DNA to get {his} power.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Though that would be fatal for {him}.

lines.speaker: Lab Tech
lines.text: Looking good!

finalBattle.intro.label: Final battle: the giant at the foot of the Peninsula

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Your partner has reached critical mass, soldier. It's headed for the city.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: That's not a Kaiju. That's my partner.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Hold on. I'm bringing you back.

finalBattle.voices.label: Final battle: the teammate's voice, from inside the Kaiju, as each wave comes

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: I can hear you... I can't stop walking...

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: They're coming for you... because of me...

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: Keep going... it's working... I can feel it fading...

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: This is going to hurt. Hold still.

lines.speaker: teammate
lines.text: ...Did I... hurt anyone?

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: You're back. That's all that matters.

guy.name: Guy
guy.bio: Pulled from a collapsed overpass the night the Kaiju first made landfall, more wreck than man. The Lab took what was left. He still takes his coffee black.

girl.name: Girl
girl.bio: Kept a whole squad alive through the harbor attack, then took a fall no one walks away from. The Lab rebuilt her from scratch. Her mind now makes the split-second calls that keep her team alive. She hasn't lost anyone yet.

hazmat.name: Hazmat Worker
hazmat.bio: Hard worker. Punctual. Never noticed the tear in his suit while sweeping up one day. Now he's part of the crew.

punk.name: Punk Guy
punk.bio: Touched a Kaiju part on a dare. Grew a garden out of the subway platform and a chip on his shoulder to match. Re-education took. The mohawk stays.

black_female.name: Ghost Girl
black_female.bio: Says the dead talk to her. Since the Kaiju part, they talk back, with teeth. Her powers are like none on file, and they eat away at her health. A glass cannon with heat-seeking missiles.

mermaid.name: Aquarium Worker
mermaid.bio: Gave the dolphin show for six years, until a Kaiju tongue fell into her tank. Mentally, she's a mermaid now. Still a real crowd-pleaser.
